verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is designed as a fully local, dependency-free inference engine with CLI/server modes, optimized backends for CPU (AVX/NEON), Apple Silicon (Metal), and GPUs (CUDA/HIP/MUSA), plus quantization to fit models on consumer hardware—confirmed by hands-on community reports running 7B-70B models entirely on personal Macs and desktops with no cloud dependency. missing for 10: no explicit first-party statement about data/privacy guarantees, only implicit architectural evidence.
